questions.article: Navigating the New Year with Purpose and Wisdom
questions.q: On which date is New Year’s Day celebrated across the world?
options: January 1st
By the Common Era calendar.
July 1st
Not quite. The article says: January 1st.
October 2nd
Not quite. The article says: January 1st.
March 21st
Not quite. The article says: January 1st.
questions.rationale: The commencement of a new year occurs on January 1st.
